name: Cooked PT: Coach Your Clients
subtitle: Personal trainer software
promo: Get found by new clients, get your own website, and coach every client from your phone. No client limits.
description:
Cooked PT is the coaching app for personal trainers. Get found by new clients, run your own website, and coach everyone from one app. Your clients use Cooked, and what they choose to share shows up for you automatically.

GET NEW CLIENTS
- List yourself in the Cooked trainer directory, where people near you look for a trainer
- Answer client requests and turn them into clients
- Your own website, built for you from your profile: pick a template and publish, and leads from its contact form come straight to you

YOUR CLIENTS
- See each client's workouts, food, weigh-ins and steps, only with their permission
- Set goals, habits and nutrition targets
- Keep private notes only you can see

PLANS
- Build workouts and multi-week programs in your library
- Put workouts on a client's calendar and see when they're done
- Start from templates or let the builder draft a program for you to edit

MESSAGES AND SCHEDULE
- One inbox for every client, with quick replies
- Book sessions in person, by live video or online
- Reminders before each session

YOUR BUSINESS
- A profile with your specialties, certifications, prices and reviews
- Group coaching and challenges
- Get paid by clients through your own booking and payment links, or in the app

PRICING
- Coach as many clients as you like: no client limits
- The directory listing is $29 a month, with the first 14 days free

Your clients connect from the Cooked app, and they decide what you can see.

reviewNotes: Sign in with the account above (tap Sign in, then use the username and password). Clients connect to a trainer from the Cooked app. Notifications are asked for so trainers hear about new client messages.
